card.name: Letters inside longer split words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces such as 'ra', 'CA' or 'la' that sit inside a longer word split across pieces, most strongly the 'ra' in barn-raising, fundraiser and puppy-raising.

modes.label: Raising compounds
modes.description: The 'ra' piece in compounds ending in -raising or -raiser.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Short pieces inside names or long words, such as PRECAUTIONS, granddaughters and Vlaanderen.

card.writes: It favors short capital-letter pieces and suppresses Chinese words and word endings, with no clear overall effect.
card.plain: It fires on a short chunk in the middle of a split-up word, especially the 'ra' in fundraiser.
